(BY SHRI SANTOSH SINGH THAKUR, GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Heard and perused the case diary.

This is second bail application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of applicant relating to F.I.R. No. 206/2023 dated 26.04.2023, registered at Police Station-Tejaji Nagar, District-Indore for the offence under Section 304-B, 498A and 34 of IPC.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the present applicant is that she taunted the deceased due to which the deceased committed suicide.
Accordingly, a case has been registered.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is mother- in-law of the deceased.
The applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is in jail since 28.04.2023.

It is further submitted that the charge-sheet has been filed and Final conclusion of trial Radha Bai More vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190557460/
1 will take considerable long time, hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.
4.

entities.text: Radha Bai More vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per-contra, learned Government Advocate for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.

5. Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that the applicant is in jail since 28.04.2023 and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
6 . Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

She shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S. 437(3) Cr.P.C.
7.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
8. The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
